records.reason: While transformed the merfolk gains a 25-foot land Speed (replacing the ancestry swim Speed) — a real Speed change on the sheet with nothing delivering it. Modelled as a toggleable polymorph mode; the loss of the ancestry swim Speed is stated in the note since a mode can only grant speeds, not remove them.

mode.name: Shore Gift
mode.duration: indefinite (use the action again to revert)
mode.note: You walk on two legs: land Speed 25 feet. You lose the swim Speed from your merfolk ancestry (swim Speeds from other sources remain). Counts as a disguise for Impersonate and automatically defeats passive Perception DCs to spot it.

records.reason: Ignoring shallow-water difficult terrain is GM-adjudicated terrain, and the success-to-critical-success upgrade on Balance/Swim is resolved on the roll at the table — no sheet statistic changes.
Permission to crew a siege weapon below its minimum, with a penalty applied to the siege weapon's own crew checks at the table; no player statistic changes.
A reaction that redistributes an enemy's critical-hit damage between you and an ally; entirely resolved at the table.
Grants a one-action Strike activity whose extra results apply off-guard to the target (or to you on a critical failure); resolved at the table.
A free action that lets you Trip after a successful Shove; an action resolved at the table, no sheet change.
A reaction that Shoves a moving enemy; affects only the target and is resolved at the table.
Widens Pistol Twirl's Feint to every enemy in range against their Perception DCs — a table-resolved retargeting, no statistic changes.
An action that changes the eidolon's size and reach; the app does not track creature size/reach as a derived statistic and the toggle is resolved at the table.
Imbues a worn ikon with a Transcendence activity (Skirt the Underworld); grants an action resolved at the table, no numeric sheet change.
Grants concealed/hidden status against out-of-water opponents while fully underwater — a GM-adjudicated visibility state, not a numeric modifier.
Applies Sickened 1 to the TARGET of your jaws Strike; changes only a target's statistics.
Positional flanking rule between you and your animal companion; adjudicated on the map, no sheet statistic.
Positional flanking rule between you and your animal companion; adjudicated on the map, no sheet statistic.
A reaction that redirects a missed Strike to another creature; entirely resolved at the table.
A free action granting quickened for the turn, restricted to light-mortar actions; action economy resolved at the table.
You learn the sign forms of languages you already know — no fixed language is granted (grantsLanguages needs named languages) and the rest is roleplay/GM adjudication.

Grants two additional signature spells of base rank 3rd or lower — a genuine player PICK. The builder stores signatures as Record<rank, spellId> (BuildState.signatures, src/rules/build.ts ~222 and Builder.tsx ~661), one per rank, so a sorcerer cannot designate a second signature at any rank ≤3 and this feat does nothing. No existing field can express extra signature slots.

fix.lane: extra signature-spell picks beyond the one-per-rank cap (2 more, restricted to base rank 3 or lower)

records.reason: Grants expert proficiency in medium and heavy armor — an armor-proficiency grant, the FEAT_LANE_GRANTS lane (src/rules/featGrantsLane.ts, cf. 'knight-in-shining-armor'). Nothing delivers it today. FeatGrant has conditionalSkills but no conditional ARMOR track, so the printed gate ('if you have expert proficiency in any armor or unarmored defense') cannot be encoded; at this feat's level 12 every class that can reach the archetype already has expert in some armor or unarmored defense or gains it at 13, so the flat grant matches the printed values.
A two-action Strike that silences the TARGET; changes only the target's statistics.
A reaction Strike that disrupts the triggering caster's spell; resolved at the table against a target.
Duplicate printing of the same reaction; a table-resolved Strike affecting only the triggering caster.
Duplicate printing of the same reaction; a table-resolved Strike affecting only the triggering caster.
An action: Strike plus a save against your class DC imposing stunned/silence on the target; affects only the target.
Compresses Step plus Hide/Sneak into one action; action economy resolved at the table.
A two-action Strike imposing a Speed penalty, poison damage and immobilization on the TARGET; changes only the target's statistics.

Grants the Read Aura and Sigil cantrips as at-will arcane innate spells. Both spells exist in core.json ('read-aura', 'sigil') and the innateSpells field with atWill is the shipped shape for at-will innate cantrips; nothing currently puts them on the Spells tab. Not a pick, so FEAT_CANTRIP_GRANTS does not apply.
An action that lets your student react with their own Strike and pools the damage for resistances; affects an ally's action and the target, resolved at the table.
Loosens which spell you may expend for Counterspell; a rules permission applied when the reaction is used at the table, not a sheet statistic.
A spellshape action adding persistent bleed to the TARGET of your next spell; changes only the target.

A two-action activity granting a chosen temporary rune effect to you and all allies within 30 feet for a round; a party-wide temporary effect chosen and tracked at the table, not a build-time sheet change.

Teaches the companion a one-action activity that damages a creature it already has grabbed; an action resolved at the table, not a companion statistic (no COMPANION_MODS field covers granted activities).
A two-action unarmed Strike dealing extra void damage and yielding temporary Hit Points based on the damage dealt; resolved at the table per use.
An action that regains an expended spell slot in exchange for drained; a mid-combat resource swap resolved at the table, not a build-time slot bonus.
Redirects Vampiric Feast's temporary Hit Points to an ALLY; changes only an ally's statistics.
Adds GM-rolled secret checks during exploration to notice haunts, spirits and ethereal creatures; not one of the modelled senses and entirely GM-adjudicated.
Ignores difficult terrain in aquatic environments; terrain handling is GM-adjudicated and not a sheet statistic.
Lets you perform simple Interact actions with a tail, explicitly excluding anything requiring a check; pure flavour with no statistic.
Combines Step and Strike into one action; action economy resolved at the table.
Improves how far the Crawl action moves you; a movement-action rule, not a Speed value on the sheet.
Upgrades Goblin Scuttle's Step to a half-Speed Stride; a rules change to another feat's reaction, resolved at the table.
Lets you Sneak at full Speed; a movement-action rule, not a Speed value or modifier.
Communicate with and use Diplomacy on arachnids, with the GM deciding which creatures qualify; explicitly GM-adjudicated.
A two-action Strike-then-Trip activity with a multiple-attack-penalty timing note; resolved at the table.
Lets you choose a rune effect or precious material for each use of Slayer's Strike; a per-use choice made at the table that only affects how damage lands on the target.
Turns Frighten Undead into a free action after a successful identification and adds a fleeing rider on a critical success; affects only the undead target.
A two-action Strike dealing extra vitality dice to undead, scaling at 10th and 18th; extra damage on a specific activity resolved at the table, not a persistent Strike modifier.
A one-action Strike that automatically Repositions the target and makes it off-guard on a failure; affects only the target.
Turns an 8-hour rest into the effects of a long-term rest; a downtime/recovery activity the app does not model.
An action replacing Grapple's success effects with clumsy/unconscious on the target; affects only the target.
Grants the Daydream Trance action, which exists in core.json and is already linked from the feat's descRefs; an action resolved at the table with no statistic change.
A one-action Strike that also Steals an object when the attack roll beats the target's Perception DC; resolved at the table.

Grants the initial deed of the way chosen in Gunslinger Dedication; every way's initial deed (Into the Fray, Ten Paces, Covered Reload, Living Fortification, etc.) is an action or reaction resolved at the table, so no sheet statistic changes.
An extra reaction per creature's turn usable only for gunslinger reactions; action economy resolved at the table.
A reaction that moves a willing ALLY 15 feet; affects only an ally's movement.
Extends the Sneak action by 5 feet and keeps you unobserved in dim light; a movement/stealth action rule, not a Speed value or modifier.
Your darkness spells dim nearby bright light, letting you Hide; a battlefield lighting effect adjudicated at the table.
A one-action Escape-plus-follow-up activity; resolved at the table with no statistic change.
Lets you attempt a Deception check against a mind-reading or identity-revealing effect's DC; an optional counter-check rolled at the table, not a bonus to any statistic.
